articles.body: Not every project needs to be a platform. Some of the most useful lessons I've learned came from small tools built in an evening to solve one problem. Here are three from my GitHub, and the lesson each one taught me. 1. The vaccine-slot checker: ship the thin slice cowin-vaccine-availability · Java 11, Spring Boot 2.5 · 2021 During India's COVID-19 vaccination drive in 2021, booking a slot on the CoWIN portal was a race. Slots appeared and were gone within seconds, and there was no notification — you refreshed and hoped. The plan was simple: poll the public CoWIN API for my district and raise an alarm the moment a slot opened.

articles.title: Private SaaS User Documents: Choosing Object Storage and Presigned Download Links
articles.excerpt: Tenant isolation is the constraint that changes this storage decision. Short answer: keep user documents in private object storage, keep the tenant-to-object mapping in the application database, and c…
articles.body: Tenant isolation is the constraint that changes this storage decision. Short answer: keep user documents in private object storage, keep the tenant-to-object mapping in the application database, and create a short-lived presigned download link only after checking that mapping. For a media SaaS with US and EU tenants, that authorization path matters more than a provider's SDK ergonomics or a headline rate. The runbook starts with one question: can an operator trace a download from an authenticated tenant to an authorized object key? If the answer depends on a filename, a URL supplied by the browser, or a bucket prefix, stop there. Those are locations, not identity. How should a SaaS team define the boundary for private files?

articles.title: Transactional Email Deliverability Setup: Custom Domain Receipts With Owned Templates
articles.excerpt: Template ownership is the first decision in a fintech contact-form email pipeline: give support control of approved receipt wording, while the platform team controls the sending domain, recipient elig…
articles.body: Template ownership is the first decision in a fintech contact-form email pipeline: give support control of approved receipt wording, while the platform team controls the sending domain, recipient eligibility, and release gate. TL;DR: verify the custom domain, configure DKIM and SPF with DMARC alignment, and process bounce and complaint events into a suppression list before subsequent transactional sends. A Node.js form handler can own request intake; delivery policy should remain explicit enough to survive a change of language or email provider. Consider a bounded production design exercise: a contact marked disputed_transfer goes to the payments support queue, and that assignment becomes durable before the application attempts a receipt to the customer.

articles.title: Four public registries, one lead list: the pipeline, and the psychology of the 30 seconds before someone buys
articles.excerpt: Everyone selling B2B data is selling the same thing: a scrape of LinkedIn, three years stale, resold twelve times. Buyers know this. That is why the first sentence out of any prospect's mouth is "we a…
articles.body: Everyone selling B2B data is selling the same thing: a scrape of LinkedIn, three years stale, resold twelve times. Buyers know this. That is why the first sentence out of any prospect's mouth is "we already have a list." I build the other kind. Datasets rebuilt from the original government registry, so every row can be verified by the buyer in a browser tab. Four of them so far, and the lessons are worth writing down. 1. Find a registry that updates on a schedule Not a directory. Not an aggregator. The primary source, the one the government itself runs. UK Care Quality Commission publishes a full CSV of every registered care location in England. About 57,000 rows, refreshed monthly, OGL licensed. One HTTP GET, no browser required. SEC Form D filings, weekly.

articles.body: Un’architettura moderna per analizzare transazioni sul tuo dispositivo, con controllo umano, output strutturati e integrazione sicura con agent e strumenti esterni. Nel mondo della finanza personale c’è un paradosso evidente: gli strumenti “smart” sono spesso utili proprio perché vedono tutto… ma per funzionare chiedono di consegnare dati estremamente sensibili. Se in altri ambiti può essere un compromesso accettabile, su transazioni, entrate, abitudini di spesa e debiti la soglia di tolleranza cambia: privacy e controllo non sono optional. Un’alternativa concreta è un approccio local-first : dati cifrati sul dispositivo, AI che gira nel browser, sincronizzazione opzionale e governance esplicita di ciò che può essere letto o fatto.

articles.title: Securing Your EKS Cluster for Production: Eight Checks You Can Prove
articles.excerpt: Amazon EKS runs the Kubernetes control plane for you, but that is only half of the shared responsibility model. Access, nodes, pods, encryption and monitoring are still yours. That is where teams slip…
articles.body: Amazon EKS runs the Kubernetes control plane for you, but that is only half of the shared responsibility model. Access, nodes, pods, encryption and monitoring are still yours. That is where teams slip. Wiz's 2025 Kubernetes Security Report, based on more than 200,000 cloud accounts, found that new EKS clusters were targeted within 28 minutes of creation, and that 81% of EKS clusters still used the deprecated ConfigMap authentication mode. Red Hat's 2024 survey found that 89% of organizations had a container or Kubernetes security incident in the past year. This post is a checklist of eight controls. Each one has how to set it, a command that proves it, and what a failure looks like. A script at the end checks the provable ones before go-live. Group 1: Lock the door 1.

articles.excerpt: Enterprise networks are under severe strain. As companies rush to deploy artificial intelligence, the technology is quickly becoming the biggest source of demand on the network. Now, agentic AI is add…
articles.body: Enterprise networks are under severe strain. As companies rush to deploy artificial intelligence, the technology is quickly becoming the biggest source of demand on the network . Now, agentic AI is adding to the load. Tasks conducted by AI agents generate an estimated 450% more network traffic than the same tasks done by human workers. As AI inference shifts from hyperscale training clouds—the huge centralized data centers where raw AI models ingest vast datasets and learn—to real-time, latency-sensitive applications, the need for on-premises or near-premises infrastructure grows. As a result, the gap between enterprise networks that are ready to support AI and those that are not is widening.

articles.title: Double asteroid solar eclipse caught on camera | Space photo of the day for Nov. 24, 2026
articles.excerpt: A spacecraft far from Earth beamed home a rare sight: a solar eclipse caused by one asteroid casting its shadow on another.
articles.body: (Image credit: ESA) A spacecraft far from Earth beamed home a rare sight: a solar eclipse caused by one asteroid casting its shadow on another. What is it? The image shows the Didymos double asteroid system , which consists of the larger Didymos and its moonlet, Dimorphos. In this image, Dimorphos' shadow can be seen on the surface of Didymos. The image was captured by the European Space Agency's (ESA's) Hera probe, which was sent to rendezvous with Didymos. Once there, Hera's job is to inspect the system to study the aftermath of NASA's historic DART mission (Double Asteroid Redirect Test), which slammed a kinetic impactor into Didymos in September 2022 in an attempt to alter its trajectory.

articles.title: YunLone Galaxy star projector review — a sub-$30 customizable night light
articles.excerpt: The YunLone Galaxy Projector is inexpensive but competent and offers a surprising amount of customization.
articles.body: The YunLone Galaxy Projector is an inexpensive but effective way to bring the marvel of space into your living room or bedroom. Costing around $28, this star projector can display beautiful dancing auroras across your walls and ceiling, and thanks to app support, a huge range of color options are available. In fact, the color combinations you can display here are almost infinite. Key specs Size: 3.54 x 3.15 x 4.72 inches (9 x 8 x 12 cm) Weight: 17.6 ounces (500 g) Bulb Type: LED Laser: Yes Operation: App and remote control Rotation: Yes Sleep timer: Yes Speaker: Yes With built-in sounds, a Bluetooth speaker and endless customization options, this really is an all-singing, all-dancing star projector. We're amazed at just how much is loaded into this package for such a low price.

articles.title: China launching 1st international astronaut to Tiangong space station today: Watch it live
articles.excerpt: China will launch an international astronaut to its Tiangong space station today (Nov. 24) for the first time ever, and you can watch the landmark liftoff live.
articles.body: China will send an international astronaut to its Tiangong space station today (Nov. 24) for the first time ever, and you can watch the landmark liftoff live. A Long March 2F rocket is scheduled to launch the Shenzhou-24 mission from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center in northwest China today at 7:18 p.m. EST (0018 GMT and 8:18 a.m. Beijing time on Nov. 25). You can watch the liftoff live here at Space.com, courtesy of China Central Television (CCTV). China rolls out the Long March 2F rocket for its Shenzhou-24 astronaut mission on Nov. 17, 2026. (Image credit: CCTV) Shenzhou-24 will be China's 18th crewed spaceflight to date and its 12th astronaut mission to Tiangong , a three-module station that the nation finished assembling in low Earth orbit in late 2022.
